methodology_contract.causal_claim_rule: Distinguish hypothesized effect, Native/UI verified technical change and observed gameplay correlation; mechanism effect cannot be asserted without suitable controlled evidence. Negative/null results are retained.
methodology_contract.relation_graph: Track directed candidate influence edges from gameplay slider/coach scheme/rotation/training/tendency/badge/age/injury/market action to measurable consequences; qualify evidence and version each edge.

data_collection_contract.source_priority: Reuse existing Reader/REA Getter, D2/D3 pipeline or other established capture; no parallel database replacement.

acceptance_policy.core_objective: Native operation capability, a mechanism/methodology for every action, and role-specific data capture/decision information are all necessary; offline-only scaffold is NOT a completed user-requested prototype.
acceptance_policy.inventory_rule: Every capability row must have PASS with reproducible real-game proof or explicit GAP/BLOCKED with owner, reason, next allowed evidence. Do not report COMPLETE when blocking requested native operations remain unverified.
acceptance_policy.minimum_demonstrations: For each requested action category, if lawful game phase/test environment and specific Human write authorization exist, demonstrate real authorized operation and readback; where unavailable, classify BLOCKED/PARTIAL rather than substituting fixtures.
acceptance_policy.permission_rule: Human allows Gemini to research game mechanisms using REA; this does not automatically authorize live game mutation, process attachment/elevation, unauthorized bypass, or save changes. Group needed protected actions into a single scoped Human approval request for a reversible TEST save before executing.
acceptance_policy.stage_boundary: Human approved A-v1 exact source remains immutable. This direct Human instruction amends practical prototype expectations and implementation prioritization; does not forge full seven-stage runner acceptance.
acceptance_policy.review_gate: One concentrated GPT independent audit after the expanded integrated candidate, not an audit per iteration. Prior dry-run candidate remains interim evidence only.
